title: DRNAS SAT structural UUF250 untouched confirmatory validation
training_population: 60 frozen Kissat-only pilot formulas (53 solved within 5.3s, 7 timeout); structural analysis restricted to 53 solved
holdout_selection: All 40 archive entries not included in the 60 presampled pilot formulas; no timing-based exclusions
primary_endpoint: Spearman correlation with median PAR-2 for 2 repeated original Kissat attempts; unresolved timeouts scored 2*5.3s; all 40 counted
secondary_endpoint: Spearman among successfully solved formulas only; descriptive and subject to censoring
success_rule: Direction negative and two-sided permutation p<0.05 for Gini and degree CV, with BH q<0.05 across the three prespecified tests; report all regardless
independent_proof_scope: Known SATLIB UUF labels; Kissat UNSAT output is not independently proof-verified in this run
warning: Within one dataset family, not full SAT generalization; statistical confirmation does not prove cause or algorithmic advantage
